limitations: Five new challenge cases frozen before acquisition/inference; previous thirteen cases are retrospective controls.
No model parameters, timing offsets, tempo hints or thresholds retuned.
Native outside-recording pulse events are retained and counted as invalid extras in native-audit F1, rather than being hidden by the bounded interface.
Nominal GuitarSet grids and externally provided ARTBeaT events have different reference meanings; no population/full-mix rock accuracy claim.
Native downbeats retained but no downbeat/bar-phase accuracy scored.
Pretrained model training overlap not established.
